scenarios.title: A "can't play lands" effect beats "may play an additional land"

setup.notes: A has not played a land this turn. Aggressive Mining's "You can't play lands" applies to its controller.

decisions: A attempts to play a Forest from hand as a land play.
A attempts to play the second Forest from hand as a land play.

variants.label: mining_mine
variants.expected: Both land plays are illegal (can_play false for each Forest): Exploration's additional land play does not override Aggressive Mining. Both Forests stay in A's hand.

variants.label: mining_opponent
variants.delta: Aggressive Mining is controlled by B instead of A, so its "You can't play lands" applies to B only.
variants.expected: Both land plays are legal: the first Forest uses A's normal land play, the second uses Exploration's additional land play. Both Forests move from A's hand to the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A "can't attack" effect beats an "attacks each combat if able" requirement

setup.notes: B controls Pacifism, which enchants A's Bloodrock Cyclops. B has no creatures.

variants.label: pacified_cyclops
variants.expected: Bloodrock Cyclops is not a legal attacker (Pacifism's can't-attack wins over its must-attack requirement), so declaring no attackers is legal and no creature attacks. B stays at 20 life.

variants.label: pacified_bears
variants.delta: Pacifism enchants Grizzly Bears instead of Bloodrock Cyclops.
variants.expected: Bloodrock Cyclops is a legal attacker and must attack, so declaring no attackers is illegal. Declaring Bloodrock Cyclops alone is the legal declaration.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge enforces MustAttack requirements when validating the declaration; the declaration must be given explicitly.

scenarios.title: Adding and removing abilities follow timestamp order, not "can't" precedence

setup.notes: Humble: until end of turn, loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 0/1. Jump: gains flying until end of turn.

decisions: A casts Humble targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains and Island. Both players pass; Humble resolves.
A casts Jump targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Island. Both players pass; Jump resolves.

variants.label: humble_then_jump
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 0/1 and has flying: the later ability grant is not undone by the earlier loss of all abilities.

variants.label: jump_then_humble
variants.delta: The decisions swap order: A casts Jump first (tapping Island) and Humble second (tapping Plains and Island).
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 0/1 and has no abilities, flying included: the later loss of all abilities removes the earlier grant.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that Forge applies Animate RemoveAllAbilities only to abilities with an earlier timestamp.

scenarios.title: The impossible part of a discard instruction is ignored

setup.notes: Mind Rot makes the target player discard two cards.

decisions: A casts Mind Rot targeting B, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; Mind Rot resolves.

variants.label: one_card
variants.expected: Mind Rot resolves. B discards the one card in hand (Mountain moves to B's graveyard); the second discard is impossible and ignored. B's hand is empty.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.delta: B's hand is Mountain and Forest.
variants.expected: Mind Rot resolves. B discards both cards; Mountain and Forest move to B's graveyard.

variants.label: empty_hand
variants.expected: Mind Rot resolves. Both discards are impossible and ignored; nothing changes and no zone move occurs.

scenarios.title: Players' sacrifices chosen in APNAP order happen simultaneously

setup.notes: A's Blood Artist triggers on its own death or another creature's death and A targets B with each trigger.

decisions: A casts Innocent Blood, tapping Swamp.
Both players pass; Innocent Blood resolves. A chooses Blood Artist to sacrifice, then B chooses Grizzly Bears.
Both Blood Artist triggers target B; both players pass and they resolve.

variants.label: both_sacrifice
variants.expected: Blood Artist and Grizzly Bears are sacrificed together and go to their owners' graveyards. Blood Artist sees both deaths and triggers twice: B loses 2 life (18) and A gains 2 life (22).

variants.label: only_a_sacrifices
variants.expected: Only Blood Artist is sacrificed. Blood Artist triggers once: B loses 1 life (19) and A gains 1 life (21).

scenarios.forge_notes: Confirm that Forge's Sacrifice effect moves all chosen cards in one batch so that the leaves-the-battlefield triggers see both deaths.
